critical.issue: Endpoint does NOT exist in backend (returns 404 'Not found'). Frontend ProviderQueue.jsx line 27 and ProviderServices.jsx line 22 both call api.get('/providers/me').catch(()=>({data:null})) expecting the {provider,services,category,has_availability} shape that /providers/{provider_id} returns. Because the 404 is swallowed, `profile` stays null, catName stays undefined, isAutomobileProvider(profile)===false ALWAYS. For a real Automobile provider, walkin-vehicle-reg/walkin-vehicle-model inputs will NEVER appear and service-type-input will ALWAYS have 'hidden' — feature 2 & 3 gating is broken end-to-end for the Automobile use case even though it happens to produce the correct 'hidden' outcome for the hospital happy-path. Observed 5+ concurrent 404s on /api/providers/me while loading /provider/queue in the E2E run.

ui_bugs.issue: Both files call api.get('/providers/me') which 404s. Either (a) backend must add a GET /api/providers/me alias that returns {provider,services,category,...} for the authenticated provider, OR (b) frontend must call GET /api/providers/me/profile (which works, returns profile with category_id only) and then join with GET /api/categories to derive category.name. Without one of these, the Automobile-only vehicle fields will never appear for actual Automobile providers.

rca of the issue: Root cause of the /providers/me 404: server.py only defines @api.get('/providers/{provider_id}') (line 1181) and @api.get('/providers/me/profile') (line 1193). FastAPI matches '/providers/me' against the {provider_id} route → looks up db.providers.find_one({id:'me'}) → returns None → 404 'Not found'. Frontend swallows the 404 via .catch, leaving profile=null, so isAutomobileProvider(null)===false always. Mitigation options: (1) add @api.get('/providers/me') returning the same {provider,services,category,...} bundle for the authenticated user's provider, OR (2) in the two frontend consumers, use /providers/me/profile + join /categories client-side.
